item.question: How is uncertainty in performance metrics quantified for occupation models?
item.answer: Uncertainty in performance metrics is quantified by bootstrapping both the training set and test set, estimating variation across bootstrap samples, and calculating standard errors referred to as "training-set-bootstrapped" and "test-set-bootstrap."
